subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub accept this publisher-scoped follow graph API as a core API now, or pause it until the dependent controls/discovery and notification PRs are reviewed together?
rationale: The patch creates new private follow state, public API-token routes, and a product boundary that automation cannot approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept after proof and docs
options.body: Proceed with this base API once runtime proof, public contract docs, generated artifacts, and conflict resolution are complete.

options.title: Pause for stack review
options.body: Hold this base PR until the dependent controls/discovery and notification PRs are reviewed as one product boundary.

options.title: Decline this API shape
options.body: Close or redirect the stack if maintainers do not want publisher follow state exposed as a core ClawHub API now.

recommendation.title: Accept after proof and docs
recommendation.body: Proceed with this base API once runtime proof, public contract docs, generated artifacts, and conflict resolution are complete.
